faqs.title: Are programs suitable for beginners?
faqs.text: This demo shows how program levels and prerequisites can be presented. All current programs are fictional examples.

faqs.title: Are sessions online?
faqs.text: The theme can describe in-person or remote programs. There are no real sessions or scheduled dates in this demo.

faqs.title: Does this form register me?
faqs.text: No. Forms are local demos: they do not reserve a place, send information or issue certificates.
